pixelScope: One native 64×64 crop per expected pilot contact; overlapping crops count repeated pixels separately. Preview shows the first pilot only.
checks: Exact true-circle centre/radius and complete arc
Unchanged bright width and visible pixel contribution
Omitted/default native raster identity in every pilot crop
Changes bounded to contact regions in every pilot crop
limitation: Actual renderer pixel evidence on synthetic frozen checkpoints; not human readability, mission, art, performance or device approval.
